mapper.select: SELECT store_id, store_name, category, region, address, phone, latitude, longitude, image_path, created_at FROM store ORDER BY store_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store WHERE store_name = #{storeName} AND address = #{address}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO store (store_name, category, region, address, phone, latitude, longitude) VALUES (#{storeName}, #{category}, #{region}, #{address}, #{phone}, #{latitude}, #{longitude})
mapper.select:
SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.category, s.region, s.address, s.image_path, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 1) AS avg_rating, COUNT(r.review_id) AS review_count, (SELECT r2.title FROM review r2 WHERE r2.store_id = s.store_id ORDER BY r2.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS one_liner FROM store s LEFT JOIN review r ON s.store_id = r.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, s.category, s.region, s.address, s.image_path ORDER BY review_count DESC, s.store_id LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
mapper.update: UPDATE store SET image_path = #{imagePath} WHERE store_id = #{storeId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT region FROM store WHERE region LIKE '부산%' ORDER BY region
